title: Japanese Coconut Frittata
description: A unique Japanese-inspired twist on the classic Italian frittata, featuring coconut milk and Japanese flavors.
instructions: 2. Whisk together coconut milk, eggs, aromatic, citrus, italian, salt, and black pepper.
3. Heat a 9-inch (23 cm) oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
4. Add a small amount of oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
5. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes.
6. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
7. Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
8. Use a spatula to loosen the edges of the frittata from the skillet.
9. Slide the frittata onto a serving plate and garnish with additional citrus, if desired.
10. Slice the frittata into wedges and serve.
